card.name: Inside brand and device names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a brand or device name split into parts, such as the end of ViaLok, Luer-Lok, AquaGlo or Oxytrol. Seen in product labels and instructions for use.

modes.label: Luer-lock and ViaLok
modes.description: The ending of the connector names ViaLok and Luer-Lok in preparation steps.

modes.label: Other product names
modes.description: The ending of a trade name for a patch, gel or device.
modes.example: Apply OXYT<<ROL>> transdermal system twice weekly
